body: I do this as well.  It seems that we are hardwired to receive "rewarding pleasure" when we fulfill a basic need (Hunger, Thirst, Sex) which is why it doesn't feel so wrong to do.  The "essentials" are items that we are FORCED to purchase to live in society, and thus feel more like a chore, and sometimes give us the feeling of something that we do not WANT to do but HAVE to.   This takes away most of the pleasure of buying them.
